summary.name: Google Chrome
summary.one_liner: Google Chrome is the official web browser from Google, offering performance, tab management, password management, safety tools and Gemini AI features.
use_cases: save and autofill passwords and addresses
check browser security and privacy settings
pay for things online with Google Pay
summary.what_it_does: Chrome is Google's web browser. It includes tab tools such as groups, labels, color coding, vertical tabs and split view that shows two tabs side by side. Performance features include Energy Saver and Memory Saver. Built-in Google Password Manager saves and generates passwords, and Safe Browsing, Safety Check and Privacy Guide cover security and privacy. Gemini in Chrome, AI Mode and Google Lens are integrated into the browser, and extensions are available from the Chrome Web Store.
notable: Gemini in Chrome AI assistant with auto browse for tasks
Vertical tabs and split view for two tabs at once
Built-in Google Password Manager and Safety Check
caveats: Some Gemini in Chrome features are marked with an asterisk and may have conditions not shown in the text
